LESSON: POOL SAFETY SWIMMING

Grade: PP2
Subject: PSYCHOMOTOR AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 11
Topic 11.1: Pool safety SWIMMING

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Pool safety SWIMMING. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify basic water safety and hygiene rules for application in the pool
2. demonstrate ability to follow safety rules accordingly Core-Competence

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify basic water safety and hygiene rules for application in the pool
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to identify basic water safety and hygiene rules for application in the pool. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. demonstrate ability to follow safety rules accordingly Core-Competence
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to demonstrate ability to follow safety rules accordingly Core-Competence. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Pool safety SWIMMING.
2. Explain Pool safety SWIMMING to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: Encourage learners to pool follow safety rules b) demonstrate ability to accordingly follow safety rules accordingly Core-Competence
4. Show that you can: identify basic water safety and hygiene rules for application in the pool
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Pool safety SWIMMING. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Pool safety SWIMMING important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS
